June, Gideon's 1 Jul post in #strategic-pod (09:17) says he closed **ticket #8841** with support that morning. The fix was that Vantorre's IT cleared a browser cache issue on the kiosk tablets, after which the standard Detention Summary template worked for their billing team.

One thing to check: a 16 Apr email from Ruth also refers to #8841, describing it as the Allentron 2nd-shift gate log export review, so the number may have been used for two different issues.
